harbor_extra_docker_steps:
python3 -c "import hashlib, pathlib, shutil, struct; CUT = "2016-01-01"; CAL = "557a9ef7a12fbefb654270f7cd825d72faa68a10da4ceed09d1b1031fe12ef4c"; INST = {"csi300": "fc0b62443aaffbd1d3a6c7aa96a40fdbc054f73b3a33ed814222f45842ffbe64", "csi100": "2eebacab048c6c3fc93f783a42805d7c09ec197013c3e06ba3135f2e40ad7b1a"}; AGG_FULL = "69bc06861408dad9b529b354155db1bf6709d08275041179d18050fd516d874c"; AGG_VIS = "9e83ad2eace13da8b46b12dbd68dee3a9a29558a668fb37962bef51c1e69dbc7"; exec('root = pathlib.Path("/root/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data")
assert hashlib.sha256((root / "calendars/day.txt").read_bytes()).hexdigest() == CAL, "unexpected calendar"
cal = (root / "calendars/day.txt").read_text().splitlines()
K = sum(1 for d in cal if d < CUT); last = cal[K - 1]
U = {"sh000300"}
for n, h in INST.items():
 p = root / "instruments" / (n + ".txt"); assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == h, "unexpected " + n
 rows = [l.split(chr(9)) for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
 U |= {r[0].lower() for r in rows}
 p.write_text("".join(r[0] + chr(9) + r[1] + chr(9) + min(r[2], last) + chr(10) for r in rows if r[1] < CUT))
full = hashlib.sha256(); vis = hashlib.sha256()
for inst in sorted(U):
 d = root / "features" / inst
 if not d.is_dir():
  continue
 for f in sorted(d.iterdir()):
  raw = f.read_bytes(); rel = "features/" + inst + "/" + f.name
  s = int(struct.unpack("<f", raw[:4])[0]); n = (len(raw) - 4) // 4; keep = max(0, min(n, K - s)); v = raw[:4 + 4 * keep]
  full.update(rel.encode() + hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()); vis.update(rel.encode() + hashlib.sha256(v).digest()); f.write_bytes(v)
assert full.hexdigest() == AGG_FULL, "unexpected source bins"
assert vis.hexdigest() == AGG_VIS, "unexpected visible prefix"
(root / "calendars/day.txt").write_text("".join(d + chr(10) for d in cal[:K]))
[z.unlink() for z in root.glob("*.zip")]
shutil.rmtree("/root/rl_data", ignore_errors=True)
(root / ".mlsb_test_withheld").write_text("Data after " + last + " of the scored universe (CSI300/CSI100 constituents, SH000300) are withheld from the workspace and mounted only for the final evaluation.")
print("withheld qlib data after", last, "for", len(U), "instruments")
')"

test -z "$(find / -xdev \( -name '*qlib_data*.zip' -o -path '/root/rl_data' \) -not -path '/proc/*' 2>/dev/null)" && python3 -c "import pathlib; cal = pathlib.Path(\"/root/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data/calendars/day.txt\").read_text().split(); assert cal[-1] < \"2016-01-01\", cal[-1]; print(\"calendar ends\", cal[-1])"
_harbor_extra_docker_steps_note: Every setting tests on or after 2016-01-01, so the agent-visible image keeps the scored universe's qlib data (every instrument ever in CSI300/CSI100 + the SH000300 benchmark) only up to 2015-12-31: the first step asserts the source calendar, index files and bins by sha256 (aggregate over 4,784 bins), truncates the calendar, the csi300/csi100 membership and each bin to its visible prefix (asserted by an aggregate sha256), deletes the full-archive zip in cn_data and /root/rl_data (HS300 5-minute bars 2005-2022, unused by this task), and leaves a .mlsb_test_withheld marker; the second proves no archive is left. Instruments outside the scored universe are untouched (beyond the truncated calendar qlib cannot index them). The withheld part lives in holdout/<task>/data/withheld/ (tests/meta/ in the bundle, mounted only at verification); scripts/_withheld_qlib.py rebuilds a full cn_data under $OUTPUT_DIR (each restored file sha256-checked, everything else symlinked) and the eval scripts pass it to run_workflow.py with the protocol's explicit dates, so the scored data are byte-identical to the measured protocol.
